⚙ YouTube API setup & channel settings

📺 YouTube Data API v3

The automatic YouTube gallery is included. New public uploads can appear automatically when visitors open Study Games. First connect a YouTube Data API key restricted to this website. Do not use an unrestricted key.

Connect your key and download a new website file. Then upload it to GitHub.

Previewing is temporary and does not connect the site for other visitors. When the preview works, tap Download connected website, then upload that new index.html to GitHub. Never send your API key in chat; a key published in website code is visible and must be restricted.

For GitHub Pages, restrict the key's website (HTTP referrer) to https://tonyjkxeasterncapeprovince-bot.github.io/* and its API to YouTube Data API v3. The public HTML will expose your restricted key, so monitor its usage.

🔗 Channel settings

Enter the channel ID (begins with UC) to make the Videos and Shorts buttons play the channel's public uploads inside Study Games. It does not download the videos.

The supplied channel ID is included in this website file for all visitors. Check that it belongs to the intended channel (your Studio screenshot showed “7letterslong”).

🎬 Play a video here

Paste a YouTube video or Short link to watch it inside Study Games.

The Videos tab shows regular public uploads in a tappable grid when the YouTube Data API key is configured. The Shorts section estimates short-form content by duration (up to three minutes): some regular short videos may also appear there. These videos stream through the embedded YouTube player rather than being downloaded. Posts must be added separately.
